# Original reproducible fixtures

These fonts are original PDFToolkit fixtures under the package's MIT license
(also preserved in `ToolkitLayout.LICENSE.txt`). They do not contain copied
third-party outlines or commercial font data.

- `ToolkitLayout.ttf`: simple outlines, explicit GSUB scripts, languages and
  features. Regenerate with `tools/build_layout_fixture.py`.
- `ToolkitUnicode.ttf` and `ToolkitUnicode.otf`: original TrueType and CFF
  outlines, horizontal metrics and Unicode cmap 4/12/14 including default,
  non-default and Mongolian variation sequences. Regenerate with
  `tools/build_unicode_fixtures.py`.

The generators fix timestamps. Their `--check` modes compare a temporary rebuild
with the committed bytes without modifying the originals. The validators use
fontTools and HarfBuzz separately from PHP.
# Advanced layout fixture

`ToolkitAdvanced.ttf` is an original MIT-licensed synthetic font generated by
`tools/build_advanced_layout_fixture.py`. It contains every contextual GSUB and
GPOS format, reverse chaining, GDEF glyph and mark classes, a mark filtering set,
single/pair/class positioning, cursive entry/exit anchors, mark-to-base,
mark-to-ligature, mark-to-mark and positioning extension lookups.

`tools/validate_advanced_layout.py` compares actual glyph identities and design
positions with independent HarfBuzz. Cursive comparison uses rendered glyph
origins and the final pen position, since the division between an advance and
an offset can differ while representing the same anchor geometry.

`ToolkitVariable.ttf` is derived reproducibly from the same original font by
`tools/build_variation_fixture.py`. Its one explicit `wght` axis drives a native
GDEF ItemVariationStore and conditional GSUB/GPOS feature tables. The independent
variation oracle also creates signed Device 1/2/3 variants in temporary files.
Device comparison permits less than one design unit solely for HarfBuzz's
integer quantization; native interpolation and feature substitutions compare
exactly at seven normalized instances.


`ToolkitAxes.ttf` extends the original variable layout fixture with asymmetric
`wght`, `wdth` axes in that font order, named-instance records and avar 1.0 maps.
It is reproduced by `tools/build_axis_fixture.py` under the same fixture licence.

`ToolkitMetricVariations.ttf` adds original vhea/vmtx and HVAR/VVAR/MVAR data
to ToolkitAxes. Reproduce it with `tools/build_metric_variation_fixture.py`.
